name: UK strikes & disruption
summary: Resident doctors strike 14–19 Nov; consultants 25–26 Nov
state: The BMA has called a six-day strike by resident doctors in England from 14 to 19 Nov, and consultants will strike on 25–26 Nov unless the government commits to formal talks (ITV, 26 Oct). These are strikes in one sector, within the Watch band. No national infrastructure failure had been reported as of 3 Nov.
for_you: Attend NHS appointments unless told otherwise; use NHS 111 for urgent care during strikes.
rubric_hit: National strike in one sector = Watch

sources.title: ITV News — Senior doctors in England plan November strike
Yahoo News — England's resident doctors to strike for six days

why: Strikes and infrastructure failures in rail, health, ports and power disrupt daily life and the economy.
drivers: Pay disputes, infrastructure failures, cyber incidents, weather.

rubric.alert: Multiple simultaneous national strikes, or nationwide infrastructure failure.
rubric.watch: National strike in one sector or major infrastructure disruption.
rubric.normal: No national-scale strikes or disruption this week.
